meta.title: Taylor Crouch | Full-stack Software Engineer
meta.description: Tokyo-based full-stack software engineer building production web applications across frontend, backend, databases, infrastructure, and multilingual product delivery.

top.subtitle: Tokyo-based full-stack software engineer building multilingual applications across frontend, backend, databases, infrastructure, and client-facing delivery.
top.summary: I build and ship production web applications across TypeScript/React/Next.js, Vue.js, WordPress/PHP, Go/Gin, and Java/Spring MVC stacks. My work spans frontend implementation, backend services, databases, production troubleshooting, small-team technical leadership, client communication, and multilingual platforms used in real operational environments. English native; Japanese JLPT N3.

experience.intro: Technical delivery spans internal tools, client-facing platforms, frontend interfaces, backend services, production support, and cross-functional collaboration. Earlier roles emphasize teaching, research, and communication in education settings.

roles.title: Full-stack Software Engineer
highlights: Developed and maintained internal and external applications across Vue.js front ends, Go services, Java/Spring MVC systems, and WordPress/PHP platforms.
Implemented user-facing features, backend functionality, database-related updates, and operational improvements across multiple environments.
Resolved production issues by investigating logs, comparing behavior across environments, identifying root causes, and deploying tested fixes.
Worked directly with clients and stakeholders to define requirements, technical solutions, project scope, and schedules.
Led teams of 2–5 developers in delivering multilingual applications.

roles.title: Volunteer Web Developer
highlights: Fixed UI/UX issues and improved responsive behavior across devices.
Supported localization improvements for a multilingual user experience.
Added Cypress end-to-end test coverage and contributed to Django backend updates.
Collaborated remotely with a cross-functional team of 10–15 members.

roles.title: Assistant Language Teacher
highlights: Collaborated with teachers to plan and deliver classes for 30+ students.
Supported curriculum and assessment preparation with a focus on clarity and accuracy.

roles.title: Research Assistant in Physics Education
highlights: Analyzed research data and presented findings at academic conferences.

roles.title: Teaching Assistant for General Physics Labs
highlights: Supported course delivery and instructed students in general physics labs.

entries.credential: B.S. in Physics; minors in Business Administration and English

mediaLibraryManager.name: Media Library Manager
mediaLibraryManager.description: Built a self-hosted full-stack application for cataloging movies, TV, music, books, and games, with a TypeScript/Vite frontend, Go/Gin REST APIs, JWT authentication, external metadata API integration, barcode-assisted lookup, MongoDB persistence, and S3-compatible object storage.
highlights: TypeScript/Vite frontend with responsive UI for cataloging movies, TV, music, books, and games.
Go/Gin services expose REST APIs with JWT authentication and user-scoped access.
External metadata integration and barcode-assisted lookup for faster cataloging of physical media.
MongoDB persistence and S3-compatible object storage in a self-hosted stack.
